title: Package install order
hints: Pattern: topological sort (Kahn's algorithm). A package is ready when all of its dependencies are already placed; keep taking ready packages until none are left.
Build two maps first: remaining[name] = set of unmet dependencies, and dependants[name] = set of packages that need it. Remember to add names that only appear as dependencies.
Keep the ready packages in a heapq so heappop always gives the alphabetically smallest; after placing a package, remove it from each dependant's remaining set and push any that become empty.
If the order is shorter than the number of packages there is a cycle. To name it, run a DFS over the leftover packages, marking nodes 'in progress'; hitting an in-progress node closes the cycle.
